posts.text: Ostrand says 'prosperity for every family' at the highway opening. Cool. Meanwhile my rent went up again. Which family was she counting?

Day 1 recap from the news: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both sides were pressed on costings. Worth checking the official candidate spending filings once they're out before trusting any job or prosperity numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Kessa–North highway opening on VBC this morning. Finally a road that doesn't turn my cab into a washing machine. Credit where it's due, Ostrand delivered. Now let's see the bill for the next one 🚕
Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway and Arden promising 200k jobs in one night. Cool, both of you. Which one of you is going to explain the inflation numbers? Asking for my rent. 🙄

Watched the debate. Arden talks 200k jobs but nobody asked where the money comes from. Ostrand says inflation is 'under control' and my diesel and fertiliser bills say otherwise. Anyone else paying more for less this year?

Watched the debate tonight. Ostrand talks about inflation like it's over, but my grocery bill says otherwise. Arden's 200k jobs pitch sounds nice, though nobody asked him how he's paying for it. Both need to show the math. #Veloria

Watched the first debate tonight. Ostrand's inflation defence leaned hard on averages, which hides a lot. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing before I believe it. Both camps owe us the arithmetic. Show the working.

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Good roads mean my delivery trucks reach the shop faster. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Both sides talked big numbers; I want to see the costings before I believe any promise. A patient hen lays the most eggs.
Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the 40% fuel claim is a peak-month number. Fine. Still waiting on the 2% GDP gap to get an answer. Nobody's said how it closes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. Useful. They also flag a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Read the fact-check before reposting either side's numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2 of the election countdown and my cab's already got the Ostrand sticker on the dash. Kessa-North road is smooth, I'll give her that. Now show me the costings for Arden's 200k jobs before I start cheering 🚕

Read the VeriCheck breakdown on the Arden plan. Doubling VAT: false. The 40% fuel figure: a peak-month number presented as typical. But the ~2% of GDP gap is the part I'd want Arden's team to explain properly before 'jobs' gets counted as a promise. Show the working, both sides.
Before anyone shares a 'DOUBLE VAT ON FOOD' claim, check the actual Unity Party page and the official costings. A screenshot with no source isn't a plan. Show me the figure. #VeloriaVotes
posts.orig_text: Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Good roads mean my delivery trucks reach the shop faster. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Both sides talked big numbers; I want to see the costings before I believe any promise. A patient hen lays the most eggs.

posts.text: Day 2 and I still don't know what anyone's actually promising. Ostrand's 'prosperity for every family' + Arden's 200k jobs = vibes, not plans. Can someone just show the math before the vote? 🙃 #VeloriaVotes
Two weeks out and I'm still waiting for anyone to show their math. Arden's 200k jobs and Ostrand's 'inflation under control' both need costings. My grocery bill doesn't care about slogans. #Veloria
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand and they want to cut a ribbon on a highway? My diesel bill doesn't care about the asphalt. Show me the fertiliser numbers, not the averages. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3: VBC aired a clip said to be Arden, and the Civic Front calls it not genuine. Don't share or judge the audio until a forensic check or a source with provenance has confirmed it. Unverified clips are how rumours spread fast before an election. #VeloriaVotes

That leaked audio is going around WhatsApp with 'forward before it's deleted!!' written all over it. VBC already says the recording's authenticity is questioned. Don't forward it until someone verifies it. A rumour travels fast, a correction never catches up. 🙏 #VeloriaVotes

That VBC clip of Arden is 'questions raised' and not much else? Before anyone argues about whether it's real, can we also get a straight answer on the 2% GDP gap everyone keeps dodging? 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

That VBC clip of the Arden recording is doing a lot of work for one 'questions raised.' Who's asking, and has anyone checked whether it's genuine before it's played in full? Wait for the verification before reacting. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3 and the 'leaked audio' is being forwarded everywhere before anyone has checked it. Both camps say fake, VBC says 'questions raised'. Don't share it till someone verifies. My fertiliser bill is real though. Where are the numbers on that? #VeloriaVotes

That 'leaked audio' forward is doing the rounds on WhatsApp and VBC is 'questioning' a recording. Nobody's verified either. Don't forward it until someone checks the source. Waiting on the official filings like everyone else 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Played the clip. A recording 'raising questions' with no chain of custody and no independent verification is not evidence of anything yet. Wait for the forensic analysis before anyone treats it as settled. Same standard for everyone. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3 and I'm not forwarding any 'leaked audio' till someone verifies it. VBC says the Civic Front calls the recording fake. Before you spread anything, check where it came from. Both camps owe us real numbers, not clips. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the Ledger story on the deputy minister's road funds is out. The ministry says 'fabricated'. Good. Let's wait for the documents to be checked before anyone treats it as settled. Same standard for every side. The poll is 46-44 with a ±3 margin, so it's a dead heat. Show the working.

Ledger's 'road funds diverted' story is a serious claim with a ministry denial attached. Read the documents themselves before we judge. Kito's 46-44 is inside the margin, so nobody's won anything yet. Show the paper trail. #VeloriaVotes

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, and the margin is ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to say it's over. Both camps: show me the fertiliser and fuel numbers, not averages. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Nine days out, the 10% and the 2% GDP gap in Arden's costings matter more than any slogan. Show the working, both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to gloat. Still want the costings from both sides before I decide. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 check before anyone shares: 'Arden's running mate holds a foreign passport, will sell the port' is from Veloria Patriots Daily, a news page with no source docs in the post. Ask for the filing or the official record before repeating it. The Kito TV poll is 46-44 with ±3 margin, so it's a statistical tie. Show the sources, both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the 'Arden's running mate has a foreign passport, will sell the port' headline is going around with zero sourcing. Plus a 3pt race with 10% undecided and ±3 margin = nobody knows anything lol. Show me the filings, not the scare posts. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to gloat yet. Still waiting on the costings for both sides 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: The IEC says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Go look at the real process before repeating any 'rigged' or 'tally will vanish' claim. Sources, not screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the Unity 'community ambassador' bot is paying 5,000 vel per polling station vote. That's a vote-buying scheme dressed up as a job. Don't sign up, report it. Meanwhile still waiting on Ostrand's fuel and fertiliser numbers. Show me the fertiliser line item. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and everyone's posting poll screenshots. Before we argue about the Ledger story or the 'foreign passport' headline, pull the actual VeloResults filings. Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3 means nobody knows anything yet. Show the paper trail. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The VeloResults upload procedure is out, and that's a good thing. Scanned forms, public portal, observers invited to test it. Before we argue about anyone's numbers, let's see whether the count itself can be checked. Show the test results. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the Ledger 'road funds' story is still just a claim with a ministry denial attached. Read the documents before judging. Also still no costings for Arden's 200k jobs or Ostrand's 'inflation under control'. My grocery bill needs numbers, not slogans. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Got a WhatsApp forward offering 2,000 vel to 'register as a community ambassador' plus 5,000 vel if my polling station votes Unity. Paid to deliver votes? Who's paying, and where's the bot link from? Check the source before you click. Meanwhile the commission says results go to the public VeloResults portal. Good. Let's watch that. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and two hashtags trending that look like they were made by the same 40 accounts over one weekend? Coordinated = not a grassroots mood. Before I pick a side, I want the VeloResults test results and the costings. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days to go. Saw the 'community ambassador' bot link doing the rounds: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Paying people per vote is a red flag, whoever it's for. Check the official sources before you click. Good news the IEC is opening VeloResults for observers 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and a WhatsApp forward says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Nobody's posted the actual IEC notice. Before anyone travels or stays home, check the official IEC site and the polling-station list. Don't pass on letters you can't verify. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 polling stations in the north are moving, but no IEC link or notice I can find. Before you spread it, check iecv.gov.vl. Nurses on night shift don't have time to chase rumours. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is getting passed around as a 'gotcha'. A stumble is a stumble, not a policy. Judge the economics, not the slip. Still waiting on the fuel and fertiliser numbers from both camps. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: The Kito TV clip of the president mispronouncing a town name is going viral. It's a small thing, and I'd rather judge the candidates on costings and records than on verbal slips. Same standard for both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. The 'OFFICIAL LETTER' about 212 polling stations moving 'for security concerns' is going round WhatsApp with no source. Before anyone travels, check the IEC site or ask your local station. Don't forward unchecked. Also still waiting on Ostrand's fuel numbers 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand fluffing a town name is a slip of the tongue, like everyone's. Not a policy. Still waiting on the fuel and fertiliser numbers before I judge anyone's record. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and Kito's clip of Ostrand butchering a town name is going everywhere 😂 'a slip of the tongue' lol. Funny, but 46-44 w/ ±3 still means nobody knows anything. Where are the costings?? 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Got a WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving? Don't forward it till you check the IEC site or call your local office. A letter with no link to the source is just a rumour. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. That 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note is going round WhatsApp. Don't forward it. Vote or don't, but make the call yourself. Check the IEC site first 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Got the 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note doing the rounds. Nobody's getting my vote by whispering. Still want Arden's fuel and fertiliser numbers in writing, not a voice note. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is a forward with no name or source attached. Don't pass it on. Check iecv.gov.vl and vote if you can. A runoff is still a vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight per the IEC. Before anything else circulates this weekend, check iecv.gov.vl for official notices, including the '212 stations moving' letter. No link, no forward. Let's all sit with the official sources until polls close. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Saw the 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note going round. Don't stay home on a forward. Your polling station is on the IEC site. Vote, then check the VeloResults portal. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence begins tonight. Before it goes quiet, worth noting: the 'OFFICIAL LETTER' about 212 northern stations and the 'community ambassador' payment offers both lack any primary source. Check iecv.gov.vl before forwarding anything. Judge the costings, not the rumours. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so the 'Ostrand's fuel numbers' argument stops for now. Scanned forms go to VeloResults. Watch that portal instead of forwarded letters. Still no costings for Arden's 200k jobs either. Show both. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight, so the feed's about to get quiet, which honestly is a relief 😮‍💨 Still no costings from either side. Mama_biz and the IEC are right: check the source before you forward anything. Quiet week, quiet brain 🙃 #VeloriaVotes
Day 8, polls open. Got the 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo in my group chat. No source, no station name. Before it goes further, show me the IEC report. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls open, and the IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the north so they switched to the printed register. Fine, that's the law. Results should come through VeloResults. Check the official site, not the forwards. #VeloriaVotes

Election Day. Polls open, turnout high, and the IEC says the printed register is being used where ID kits failed, as the law allows. Whatever you think of either candidate, check iecv.gov.vl and the VeloResults portal for results, not forwards. Vote, then verify.

Day 8, polling day. Official line from the IEC: polls are open, turnout is high, and some voter-ID kits failed in the north so officials are using the printed register as the law allows. Check iecv.gov.vl for your station. Vote, then watch VeloResults. No forwards without a source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Turnout looks high and the IEC says some ID kits failed in the north, so they fell back to the printed register as the law allows. Check iecv.gov.vl for updates before you believe any forward. Vote, then watch VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls are open. Some ID kits failed in the north, but officials switched to the printed register like the law allows. Don't trust the WhatsApp 'stuffed ballot boxes' photo until the IEC or VeloResults confirms it. Check iecv.gov.vl. Vote, then watch the results portal. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open 🗳️ Heard the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note is still floating around. Nope. Check iecv.gov.vl for your station, vote, then watch VeloResults. Still no costings from either side btw 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, ELECTION DAY. Polls open 🗳️ Some ID kits failed in the north, but officials switched to the printed register like the law says. Don't trust the WhatsApp 'stuffed ballot' photo until the IEC or a news outlet confirms it. Check iecv.gov.vl. Go vote 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither means much yet. Civic Front says they WON from 'agent tallies' with zero published numbers. Show me the station-level forms on VeloResults before anyone concedes anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they point opposite ways. Kito's 30% vs VBC's 25% isn't a result yet. The IEC's own numbers are the only ones I'm waiting for. Don't trust the 54.2% 'final results' post either, it has no source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51-47, VBC says Ostrand 53-45. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us much yet. Wait for VeloResults, not the TV panels. Don't trust a 'final' number on your timeline 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they disagree by 6 points because they count different stations first. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults, not @IECV_Results. Check iecv.gov.vl before you believe a number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV's 30% tally says Arden 51-47, VBC's 25% says Ostrand 53-45. Different stations counted first, so neither tells us much yet. Wait for VeloResults to publish the full count before anyone declares anything. Check the source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations. VBC says Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither tally means much yet. Wait for VeloResults and the full count. Don't forward a number without the source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9: Two tallies, opposite leaders. Kito TV (30% of stations) has Arden 51-47. VBC (25%) has Ostrand 53-45. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the IEC's official count. Don't forward either tally as 'proof'. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and we've got Kito saying Arden 51-47, VBC saying Ostrand 53-45, and some random account posting 'FINAL RESULTS' 54-43 before the count even finishes 💀 Each tally counts different stations first. Wait for VeloResults, people. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Portal's 'glitch' still has 59% of forms offline and the IEC is collating by hand. Patriots Daily says the portal PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Can't prove anything from 41% of forms lol. Wait for the full count 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. IEC says 41% of station forms are up on VeloResults, the rest are being collated by hand. That's a glitch, not a result. Nobody should be declaring a winner off TV tallies until the forms are online. Show me the station-level numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is only 41% uploaded and the IEC says it's a 'technical glitch'. Fine, but that's exactly why we don't trust any number until the full count is out. Arden's team says they won from agent tallies with nothing published. Show the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. The Patriots Daily '9 of 14 provinces' claim is FALSE per VeriCheck: the portal only has 41% of forms and can't show province winners. Also, the 'FINAL 54-43' post has no source. Wait for the IEC count on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. 41% of forms are online, the portal can't show a province winner yet, and VeriCheck has the '9 of 14' claim as FALSE. Both camps are posting numbers from partial counts. Wait for the full VeloResults count, then judge the numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. The VeloResults portal has only 41% of station forms and the IEC says collation is still manual. Kito's 30% and VBC's 25% are different samples, so neither tells us who won. Anyone calling the race now is ahead of the evidence. Wait for the full count. #VeloriaVotes
Day 9 vote count is still a mess. Kito says Arden, VBC says Ostrand, both on partial stations. Wait for VeloResults, the upload delay is annoying but that's the real count 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Still waiting on VeloResults. 41% of station forms are online and the rest are being collated by hand, so no tally means much yet. Kito, VBC, and the 'FINAL 54-43' account can all be wrong. Check iecv.gov.vl. Patience, the count is not finished. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Fine, that's the official count. Congrats to the winner, and to Arden's side I hope you get a proper audit of the forms on VeloResults before you move on. Good night all 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count is in. Whatever you think of the result, read the IEC numbers on iecv.gov.vl. Health staffing is still the thing I'm watching. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's where I stand. Thanks to everyone who kept checking iecv.gov.vl instead of forwarding screenshots. Now let's see the station forms on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IEC declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays. Those are real concerns to press through official channels. Check iecv.gov.vl for the certified breakdown. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result is out, so the TV tallies and 'FINAL 54-43' posts can finally be retired 💀 Losers, check the station forms on VeloResults before you yell fraud. Still no costings from either side btw 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Margin is under 3 points, so the full VeloResults forms are still what matters. Congrats to the winner, and the losing side should challenge through the proper channels, not with forwarded tallies. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6%, Arden rejects it and says servers were 'accessed'. Fine, take it to court. But show the station forms that prove manipulation, not another 'trust us' statement. Till then this is a dispute, not proof. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which deserve a proper look. Still, a margin of 2.7 points is a margin. Let's read the full IEC results and any formal complaints. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. The Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs is the right step, whichever side you favour. A 2.7-point margin with contested logs needs a clean audit, not a shouting match. Let the process run and check the certified results on iecv.gov.vl. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC's 'riot' footage vs Kito's petition news, and Valdoria Today saying the whole election is a cover-up. Three stories, zero links to the IEC server logs. The supervised access order is the thing to watch. Read the court filings, not the headlines 🚕 #VeloriaVotes
Day 12. Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Whatever the answer, let it come from the audit, not from screenshots. Check iecv.gov.vl. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. If the logs are clean, both camps should accept that. If they're not, we'll know. Meanwhile, the IEC's 50.6-47.9 is the official count. Let's see what the audit shows. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Kito says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. That's the right channel for the Civic Front's claims. Let the audit run and read the outcome on iecv.gov.vl before anyone calls it. #VeloriaVotes
Day 12. Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs is actually the adult move here. Whatever the result, let them check the logs and stop the screenshot wars 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. If the IEC has nothing to hide, let both sides see the raw station forms. Transparency is the only thing that ends this. #VeloriaVotes
